question.prompt: What runnable starting URL should the Open Account header-presence test use?

options.label: Use placeholder
options.detail: Keep the authored `{{open_account_page_url}}` variable until a real Open Account page URL is supplied.

options.label: Provide real URL
options.detail: Replace `{{open_account_page_url}}` with the actual Open Account page URL before running the test.

content.risk_rationale: Without a starting URL, the Open Account header-presence test cannot be executed even though its oracle is otherwise fully specified.
